text.content: Decompose the R5 final object-delta action update into the unchanged R5 base path, raw-delta multiplicative gate, learned directional residual, and their full composition to identify which path contributes useful aligned-history sensitivity.

All 12 validation-only cells complete on the identical 2048-sample held-out stream and seed; every cell records action loss, applied delta RMS, delta/base RMS ratio, and delta-base cosine; base, gate-only, residual-only, and full compositions obey their exact component semantics; zero intervention yields exactly zero final-delta contribution. This is diagnostic and does not by itself authorize 20k training.
